profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer @ Motorola Solutions | MS AI Candidate @ UT Austin | MBA
profile.summary: Software engineering leader specialized in AI systems and applied machine learning for mission-critical environments. Proven track record of delivering complex systems and high-quality software efficiently and effectively. I've led production deployments inside public safety software used by law enforcement agencies nationwide. MBA that moves fluidly between engineering teams, product, and executive leadership—translating technical complexity into business impact while meeting people where they are. Bridges cutting-edge AI research and production systems. Pursuing MS in AI from UT Austin on top of years doing full-stack engineering.
